definitions.gloss: B.C., before the Common Era, BCE
definitions.explanation: The period before the year 1 in the Western calendar system. Used with year numbers to indicate dates before the Common Era.

examples.japanese: {紀元前|きげんぜん}3{世紀|せいき}の{遺跡|いせき}だ。
examples.english: These are ruins from the 3rd century B.C.

examples.japanese: エジプトの{大|だい}ピラミッドは{紀元前|きげんぜん}2500{年|ねん}ごろに{建|た}てられた。
examples.english: The Great Pyramid of Egypt was built around 2500 B.C.

examples.japanese: {紀元前|きげんぜん}5{世紀|せいき}のアテネでは、{民主|みんしゅ}{政治|せいじ}が{発展|はってん}していた。
examples.english: In 5th century B.C. Athens, democracy was flourishing.

notes:
USAGE:
Always placed before the year number: {紀元前|きげんぜん}○○{年|ねん}. This is the opposite of English word order ("500 B.C." → {紀元前|きげんぜん}500{年|ねん}). Abbreviated as B.C. in English or sometimes written as {前|ぜん}○○{年|ねん} in shorthand.

FORMS:
{紀元|きげん} (era/epoch) + {前|ぜん} (before) — literally "before the era."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紀元前|きげんぜん}○○{年|ねん}: ○○ B.C.
- {紀元前|きげんぜん}○{世紀|せいき}: ○th century B.C.
- {紀元前|きげんぜん}から{紀元後|きげんご}にかけて: from B.C. to A.D.
